_comment: Tier-2 for sparta rarefied_flow: 55 of the 121 keys in sparta_knowledge.json['commands'] are SPARTA documentation-page FILENAMES, not input-script commands. Feeding compute_grid / fix_ave_surf / dump_image / surf_react_adsorb / suffix to the installed binary gives 'ERROR: Unknown command: ... (../input.cpp:244)', while 'compute cg grid all all n' and 'balance_grid rcb cell' are accepted. Also gates the backend fix: validate_input used to validate against the doc index and waved the underscore forms through; it now validates against the 66 commands the build actually accepts. Verified by execution 2026-08-03 with SPARTA (24 Sep 2025). The binary probe skips when no SPARTA binary is present; the backend-side gate always runs. POSITIONAL ALIASES added 2026-08-06: this fixture's universal claims are also listed at their slots in the rarefied_flow row. The identity key 'universal:<n>' counts each shared claim once, which is correct; but an external counter walking rarefied_flow's 19 positional slots cannot see it and reports the claim as uncovered. Listing both makes the coverage visible under either convention; the gate collapses the alias onto the identity key so it is still counted once.
